about.title: Who are we?
about.subtitle: Discover the history, vision and governance of Bright Africa
about.history_text: The NGO BRIGHT AFRICA (BA) is a Non-Governmental Organization and Non-Profit Association, founded in accordance with Law No. 004/2001 of July 20, 2001 relating to NPOs in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
about.vision_text: To create a protective, healthy and educational environment, ensuring the well-being, safety and harmonious development of children in Africa.
about.mission_text: To promote, protect and defend children's rights by ensuring their access to education, health, protection and a safe environment.
about.ag_desc: Supreme body for guidance, decision-making and validation of the NGO's strategic orientations.
about.ca_desc: Supervisory body responsible for control, strategic guidance and program execution oversight.
about.bureau_desc: Coordination body in charge of daily monitoring and operational implementation of decisions.
about.direction_desc: Administrative and technical management body driving effective project delivery on the ground.

safeguarding.title: Safeguarding Space
safeguarding.subtitle: Protection and reporting of child rights violations
safeguarding.charter_text: Bright Africa is committed to maintaining the highest standards of child protection in accordance with Article 22 of its statutes.
safeguarding.referent_text: A Protection Officer appointed by the Board of Directors is responsible for receiving and processing all reports.
safeguarding.form_subtitle: Report any case of child rights violation in full confidentiality. Anonymity is guaranteed.
safeguarding.form_disclaimer: This report will be transmitted confidentially and encrypted to the Protection Officer and the President of the NGO.
